rae: Quick note from onboarding: our python sample app's async tool/function call path is confusing new devs. The sample shows returning a dataclass but the async client throws a serialization error in 0.14.2.

rae: Repro snippet used by new users:
```py
from dataclasses import dataclass
from redwood import AsyncClient

client = AsyncClient(api_key=ENV_TOKEN)

@dataclass
class User:
    name: str
    score: int

async def run():
    u = User(name='Toni', score=9001)
    return await client.call_tool(name='format_user', input={'raw': 'Toni,9001'}, response_schema=User)
```

toni: I hit this too. Error is `TypeError: Failed to coerce dataclass to json` in the async path, but sync client handles dataclasses fine.

sam: Can you confirm if the tool implementation returns a dataclass instance or a dict?

rae: The tool returns a dataclass instance (we map from db). If I asdict() it, things work.

rae: Stacktrace from sample container:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/main.py", line 24, in <module>
    out = await client.call_tool(...)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/client/async_client.py", line 78, in call_tool
    payload = _serialize_structured_output(schema, output)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/_struct.py", line 112, in _serialize_structured_output
    raise TypeError("Failed to coerce dataclass to json")
TypeError: Failed to coerce dataclass to json
```

kyle-devex: Thanks for the clear repro. Root cause looks like the async coercer runs in a ThreadPoolExecutor without the runtime serializer hooks, so dataclass handling is skipped. Also saw a related flake where auth refresh + retry logic for toolcall can surface as a serialization error which made this harder to triage.

kyle-devex: Plan: (1) fix async coercer to preserve hooks (or run in loop), (2) harden token-refresh retry for toolcall, (3) add CI e2e matrix for sample-app (sync/async x dataclass/dict). I'll open a hotfix PR and include a tiny sample test.

sam: Also propose updating the sample docs to show dict return as the example, plus a commented dataclass variant noting it's supported. That reduces onboarding confusion until the patch ships.

rae: Will update README with the asdict() workaround and link this thread. Happy to test the PR when available.

ci-bot: build/sample-app (python-matrix) queued for commit hotfix-dot -> job #4720

kyle-devex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3915 1 - includes fix + tests. Cutting 0.14.3 hotfix.

rae: Verified PR branch locally 1 async toolcall now accepts dataclass returns. Thanks!

toni: Thanks team. Adding a follow-up ticket to add clearer serializer errors when unsupported types hit the coercer (so new devs don't assume it's an auth or network issue).

rae: Closing this thread after docs update. If anyone else sees odd toolcall errors on async path please ping me or @kyle-devex.
